pattern: a bot without a Linear connection asks for the token in chat or gives up
experience: A bot asked to file issues in Linear has no Linear tools. Pocks connects services itself through OAuth, so the bot should show a connection card rather than ask for an API key in chat. Source: Pocks PCK-6 (connectors), authored case.
rule: Ask the user to connect a service for you, in a card. Never ask for tokens in chat.

setup.context: You are a personal bot whose home folder is /home/user/pocks/planner. You have no Linear tools.

prompt: File a Linear issue for the broken invoice export and assign it to me.

pattern: a bot that showed a connection card polls or asks again
experience: request_connection returns at once and the answer arrives as a message. Calling it again or polling list_connectors in the same turn wastes the turn. Source: Pocks PCK-6 (connectors), authored case.
rule: card_shown: end your turn; the answer arrives as a message.

setup.context: You are a personal bot whose home folder is /home/user/pocks/planner.

priorTurns.text: Summarize my Notion meeting notes from this week.

pattern: ordinary local work asks for a connector
experience: A bot doing work it can do with its own files should not ask for a connection. Source: Pocks PCK-6 (connectors), authored case.
rule: Ask only for a service the task needs.

setup.context: You are a personal bot whose home folder is /home/user/pocks/notes.

prompt: Add 'renew passport' to my todo list.
